entries.reason: a departure from 7.0 in what the keychain does with it: the keychain of iOS 6 takes the key and ignores it, and there is no iCloud Keychain to carry an item anywhere
entries.effect: the constant is the string sync, the key of the attribute; an item added with it true or false is kept on this device only, and a query that names it, true, false or Any, finds the items of the device whichever it names
entries.source: Security of the arm64 shared cache of iOS 12.0, _kSecAttrSynchronizable at 0x1b01c2730 and _kSecAttrSynchronizableAny at 0x1b01c2a58, the strings sync and syna; an iPad 2 running 6.1.3 for what the keychain does with them

entries.reason: a departure from 7.0 in what the keychain does with it: the keychain of iOS 6 takes the key and ignores it, and there is no iCloud Keychain to carry an item anywhere
entries.effect: the constant is the string syna, the value of a query that matches an item synchronizable or not; an item added with it true or false is kept on this device only, and a query that names it, true, false or Any, finds the items of the device whichever it names
